about_the_game:
ABOUT

A city consumed by terror… people are dying in the most horrific way imaginable — their heads suddenly explode without warning. Behind these gruesome deaths lurks a mysterious and malevolent being known only as the Purple Rabbit.

You are the one who dares to hunt it down. Uncover its dark secret, survive the horrors left in its wake, and face its masked followers with unnatural abilities. Every step brings you closer to the truth, but also deeper into the nightmare.

FEATURES

  • Dark and gripping story: Discover the origins of the Purple Rabbit and the truth behind the terrifying deaths.

  • Intense chases: Run, hide, and outsmart enemies with superhuman abilities.

  • Survival gameplay: Every decision could mean life… or a gruesome end.

  • Challenging puzzles: Solve mind-bending mysteries hidden within abandoned buildings.

  • Deadly traps: Outsmart terrifying mechanisms designed to end your journey in an instant.

  • Atmospheric environments: Explore haunted streets, abandoned complexes, and ominous secret rooms.

  • Unique enemies: From exploding-headed humans to masked predators, each encounter is unpredictable and deadly.
